svg.title: Nobs Autopilot wiring diagram
svg.text: 4 encoders with push · 8 push buttons · status LED
CONTROLS BESIDE THEIR PINS · USB UP · ANALOG HEADER ON THE LEFT
• Pins and placement follow arduino-esp-32-wiring.md and wiring-diagram-esp32-nano.pdf: encoders on the analog header, push
• Encoder commons: pin C and the second push-switch terminal both go to GND. ENC4 uses D3, D0 and D1, so its wires pass the
GND and RST pins: don't wire anything to RST.
